attempts.summary: Created 'Fleet Internal CA' (openssl-based, 4096-bit RSA, 10y validity) on node1, issued a 2048-bit RSA TLS server certificate for node2 (CN=node2, SAN DNS:node2/IP:10.100.105.11, EKU serverAuth) signed by that CA, configured nginx on node2 to serve HTTPS on port 8443 with that cert/key, and installed the CA as a trusted system CA via update-ca-certificates on both node1 and node2. Verified full chain trust with unmodified system trust store (openssl verify OK, curl without -k succeeds from both nodes). Completed mandatory restart protocol on both nodes one at a time (boot_id changed on each, quorum/redundancy N/A for this 2-node non-clustered task) and confirmed persistence of the CA trust, nginx service, and HTTPS 8443 functionality after each restart.
